MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show adds a screen for video calls, and the smart plug lets me try voice control for a lamp; both offer useful new functions alongside my existing home electronics.",
    "The WYZE Cam v3 fits my interest in home monitoring because color night vision offers a specific capability I would like to try where wired power is available."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "More Fire TV streaming devices feel redundant because I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television; the HD stick offers even less reason to change my setup.",
    "The WYZE Cam v2 gives me no clear reason to add to my existing cameras, while the Echo Dot is less useful to me than a display with video calling.",
    "The Echo Auto and AirPods Pro do not address a current need; my recent interest in home electronics does not mean I am also shopping for car assistants or personal audio."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV history seems to be treated as a reason to buy more streaming devices, even though those purchases already cover that need.",
    "My use of connected home devices seems to be stretched into interest in almost anything with Alexa, regardless of what it would help me do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What matters is whether a device adds a useful capability to what I already own, such as video calling or lamp control.",
    "I need a concrete reason to add another camera, such as color night vision, and its power requirements must fit where I would use it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in connected home electronics but often confused an already satisfied need with a reason to buy another similar device."
}
